summary: Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a debt offering: $450M of 4.950% Senior Notes due 2030 and $750M of 5.650% Senior Notes due 2036, issued via Rule 144A/Regulation S. No acquisition, divestiture, or special situation is involved; this is a routine debt capital markets transaction for general corporate purposes. The board recommendation, merger protections, and regulatory timelines are absent. This filing does not qualify as a special situation.
